topics.description: A recent surge in reports of fraud in Minnesota has led to the creation of a new anti-fraud task force. The task force, led by Vice President JD Vance, aims to tackle 'theft' of taxpayer money. Multiple sources, including UPI and KOKH, have reported on the task force's first meeting and its focus on Minnesota.
topics.reason: New developments in Minnesota fraud scandal

topics.description: The FBI has been involved in several investigations, including a probe into a potential assassination plot against a Palestinian activist and a hack of FBI Director Kash Patel's personal email. These investigations have been reported by Al Jazeera and other sources.
